name: Aruba
about: Sits just outside the hurricane belt, so there's no real off-season — conditions stay dry and sunny nearly year-round.
overview: One of the few Caribbean islands with reliably dry, sunny weather nearly all year — cactus and divi-divi trees instead of jungle, with steady trade winds that make it a real windsurfing and kitesurfing destination.
costOverview: Aruba runs pricier than most of the Caribbean — taxis charge government-set flat fares since there's no Uber, and even a casual grouper sandwich costs more than a similar plate almost anywhere else in the region.

specialSeasons.text: Trade winds are strongest, making this the prime window for windsurfing and kitesurfing at Fisherman's Huts.
